title: Highest Salary in Each Department
question: From the `employee` table, find the highest-paid employee in each department. Output department, first_name and salary. If several employees tie for the top salary in a department, return all of them.
reference_sql: WITH ranked AS ( SELECT department, first_name, salary, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY department ORDER BY salary DESC) AS rnk FROM employee ) SELECT department, first_name, salary FROM ranked WHERE rnk = 1
